SELECT c.id, c.name, c.phone_number AS phoneNumber, c.email, (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT r.property_name,',') FROM reservation r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id AND r.visited = TRUE ) AS visitedProperties
FROM customer c
WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM reservation r WHERE r.customer_id = c.id AND r.visited = TRUE )
AND c.id = #{id}
AND c.name ILIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND c.phone_number LIKE '%' || #{email} || '%'
ORDER BY c.id
